articles.title: Watch: KISS OF LIFE Takes 1st Win For “Who is she” On “M Countdown”; Performances By TXT, MODYSSEY, And More
articles.description: KISS OF LIFE has won their first music show trophy for “Who is she”! articles.title: ENHYPEN × Prada: New Blood, New Era
articles.description: Six young men. One Italian fashion house. A magazine that dares. And a generation that refuses to look away. Photography, Credits, Rights : DAZED, PRADA, Raf Simon, ENHYPEN / Cube Entertainment THE ARRIVAL There’s a particular voltage in the air when ENHYPEN enter a room — or a frame, or a runway, or a stage. articles.summary: ENHYPEN collaborated with Prada for a fashion editorial featured in DAZED Korea's May 2026 issue. The K-pop group was photographed wearing the Italian luxury brand's designs for the magazine spread.
